IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, July 28, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is running hot with **$54.75/hr** top scale and 42 live calls across a tight 143-hand board. Ermco's got the Google Data Center in Mooresville pushing 5-10s plus Saturday work—new construction, outdoor exposure, the kind of steady long calls that stack hours. Same crew's got the Lilly LP1 in Lebanon running 4-10s Mon-Thu. Electric Plus is staffing IU Hospital (Indianapolis) with OSHA 10 required; Malarchy Shingles Factory (Franklin) is also moving. Book's deep but moving.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** sits at **$55/hr** with Summit Line and B&D Industries both hitting that mark on serious work. Rosendin's got a kicker—**$15 incentive if you hold 90% of 60 hrs/week**—bringing effective pay to **$55-70/hr** depending on your stamina. Ten calls, 105 hands, and NM JIW License EE98J is the gatekeep here.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** has three contractors hammering Port Washington Data Center: Gurtz (**JW wage + $10/hr**), MJ Electric, and Cupertino all running 50-60 hour weeks, which means real money for hands who can eat the OT. Book's tight at 188 hands against 40 calls.

**LU-379 Charlotte, NC** is data center city: Miller Electric (QTS in Rock Hill), Gross Electric (MOC-1 in Spartanburg paying **$4 over scale**), and Industrial Electric (LNR Lenoir paying **$10 over scale**) all running 5-10s or 6-10s. Twelve calls, 98 hands—book's getting cleared.

**LU-1105 Newark, OH** runs Superior Group and Eagle across Conesville and data center work—4-10s plus Saturdays, all OT paid, 22 calls on 109 hands.

**The trend:** Data centers are the vacuum right now—Milwaukee, Newark, Charlotte, Indianapolis all feeding the same beast. Power is centralizing, and the IBEW is there for it.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Tuesday, July 28, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is the board's heavyweight right now—46 calls burning with **New River Electric Corp** chewing through 40 JWs on distribution work at **$125 night per diem plus $125 bonus on 10-hour days**, 6-10s with a CDL. Another 9 hands heading south into Ohio distro on 4-10s. **Capital Electric Line** wants 6 more for splicing work in Johnstown at **$100/day per diem**. Book depth is real here—140 hands available, which means you're competing, but the volume and bonus structure make this a serious play.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** is firing on all cylinders—10 calls, roughly 105 hands in book, and **Summit Line, Rosendin, B&D Industries, and Cupertino** all posting **$55/hr inside JW rates with all OT double time**. Rosendin's sweetener is **$15/hr incentive for hitting 90% of a 60-hour week**—that's real money if you can grind it. NM State JIW License required across most calls. This is premium inside work, competitive but high-dollar.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** landed the data-center gold—Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge build is **$44.80/hr plus $100/day per diem (non-taxed), extra $100/day for ND license**, working 6-10s. The OT sweetener is there if you stack Sat/Sun at **$150 incentive pay**. 20 calls spread across Grand Forks Air Base work too. Book's thin (55 hands), so turnaround is fast.

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** shows **ARC American posting $64.66/hr** on 12.5k distribution rebuilds in Wanatah—clean transmission work without per diem beating. Newkirk's Ball State T-Line rebuild pays **$51.79/hr with $200/day per diem**, older scale but solid per diem structure.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** pairs grid experience with **$46.80/hr from Inception Energy** in Savannah plus **$100/day per diem**, statewide call. Fairway's Columbus gig onboards 8/3 for the same rate.

Data-center infrastructure and transmission rebuilds are absorbing the board's biggest call volume right now—seasonal fire season tree work notwithstanding.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Tuesday, July 28, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running hot with 23 calls and 69 hands needed — your best shot for volume right now. BCS Mechanical has 15 calls for Journeyman Pipefitters and 14 for Journeyman Plumbers on the Sego Project West Valley build. DSI's QTS Eagle Mountain data center is calling 8 Pipefitters with **$10.00 overscale** and **$150/day per diem** if you're living 75+ miles from site. This is the board's biggest play.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits at 21 calls with tighter depth (38 hands), but the work mix is solid. US Eng. Metalworks is running 9 calls for Fitters with stainless experience on night shift at their shop. Murphy's Iron Mountain data center is moving from 5/10s to 6/10s starting August 5th — good escalation for welders willing to ramp. Olson Plumbing is running 4/10s on the Parker Advent Hospital job if you want predictable hours.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** has 10 calls but they're meaty: Nutrien shutdown shutdown work pulling 6 Pipefitters with **$11/hr incentive on straight time, $16.50/hr on OT/DT** plus **$150/day per diem over 50 miles**. Graham and Cenovus need DISA-current hands for maintenance and fab work. Gem's fab shop is testing 7 combo welders — your gate play if you're local.

**LU-213 St John, NB** and **LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** are specialty calls: Irving Oil Refinery (10 Journeyman Pipefitters via Stuart Olson) and the Holly Frontier Sinclair Refinery shutdown (12 welders, day shift, DISA required) are the industrial anchors. Perry Ellis PMI has Ellsworth AFB and Fort Meade VA callouts with **$100/day per diem**.

Data centers and refinery maintenance are pulling hands hard — industrial process work is where the per diem and overscale premiums live this week.
